findings.location: architecture.md D10 line 74 (invalidateQueries once, refetchOnMount false); shared_page_reads.qnt movesToAnotherPage and Shell
findings.obligation: Pages show the same data, sooner; no visible UI change (brief); D10: a component mounted on the new page is loading only until the answer asked on that page arrives
findings.observation: Model asks unconditionally on every move and keeps observer 1 (Shell) always mounted. TanStack invalidateQueries refetches only active queries by default. Trace for an S3 read (useTeamsQuery): page A has consumers, move to B with none mounted -> invalidate asks nothing; move to C, consumer mounts, refetchOnMount false -> no ask; cache askedOn(A) < mountPage(C) -> loading forever. The model cannot find this because Shell never unmounts.
findings.remediation: Ask on mount when cached askedOnPage < the components mount page (refetchOnMount as a function) or invalidate with refetchType all; let all observers unmount in the model and add an invariant that a mounted component with no request in flight is ready or failed, plus a mutant; add an S3 oracle row for a consumer-less page between two consumer pages

findings.location: architecture.md D10 failed when the latest ask failed, as today; qnt stayingComponentsKeepTheirAnswer guards cache.status == ready
findings.obligation: No visible UI change; permission freshness stays as today (maintainer)
findings.observation: Today a kept component never asked again, so a failed later fetch never touched it. In D10 a failed page-move ask turns every component, kept ones included, to the permissive fallback with loadFailed true, replacing a shown answer; the invariant is vacuous for status failed. Visible gated-control change in the failure case; as today is false for kept components.
findings.remediation: Decide and record: a failed page-move or own-change ask keeps a kept components last good answer (fallback only for components with no answer), or state the change for the user to accept; extend model and invariant to the failed state with a mutant

findings.observation: Evidence gap: design does not say the previous pathname and the counter are held in one state value updated in the same render-phase update. With a ref or module variable an abandoned concurrent render or StrictMode double render can advance the guard without the counter, losing a page move.

observations.text: Replayed N5 (d10-receipts/N5.qnt, differs from shared_page_reads.qnt:27 only by askedOn >= page in place of askedOn >= mountedOn.get(o)) with quint 0.33.1: stayingComponentsKeepTheirAnswer violated; unmutated allInvariants holds in a 3000-sample run. N5 is a real behavioural mutant for the refuted ready-by-current-page rule.

Soundness of set-state-during-render (architecture.md D10 line 74): the pattern is React-supported for a components own state when guarded by a stored last pathname; idempotent under StrictMode double render and abandoned concurrent renders ONLY if the last pathname and the counter live in React state, not a ref or module variable. D10 does not say which. Mount page in a useState initializer is idempotent under StrictMode.

Kept vs newly mounted match todays look in the success path (kept component never dropped its answer and never re-asked; new component loading until its answer). Header.tsx and SettingsMenu.tsx call useRbac, so for RBAC an observer is always active at a move; not true for the S3 shared reads (Teams, Portfolios, licence).

diagnostic: Rejected: S3 consumer-less intermediate page can leave a newly mounted component loading forever (model hides it behind always-mounted Shell); failed-ask look changes for kept components; mutant ids collide; render-phase state storage unspecified.
